source:
start: _ws (entry _ws)+
entry: "@" name _ws "{" _ws citation "}"
     | "@" name _ws "(" _ws citation ")"
citation: key _ws "," _ws [fields]
key: (LETTERS | NUMBER | SYMBOL)+
name: (LETTERS | SYMBOL) (LETTERS | NUMBER | SYMBOL)*
fields: field ("," _ws field)* ["," _ws]
field: name _ws "=" _ws value
value: atom _ws ("#" _ws atom _ws)*
?atom: braced | quoted | name | NUMBER

// Recursive groups balance braces without a fixed nesting limit.
braced: "{" (text | "\"" | braced)* "}"
quoted: "\"" (text | braced)* "\""
?text: LETTERS | NUMBER | SYMBOL | WS | ESCAPE
     | "@" | "," | "=" | "#" | "(" | ")"

// Disjoint terminals work with both Lark's contextual lexer and SynCode's basic lexer.
LETTERS: /[a-zA-Z_]+/
NUMBER: /[0-9]+/
SYMBOL: /[^ \t\r\n\fa-zA-Z0-9_{}"\\@,=#()]+/
ESCAPE: /\\[^\r\n]/
WS: /[ \t\r\n\f]+/
_ws: WS?
